Subject: Renewal conversation + SLA request (term: FY30)

Hi Laura,

Hope you had a good weekend. Horizon's renewal hits in July and the procurement team asked me to open a conversation about upgrading our service banding and response SLAs as part of the renewal. Usage next year is expected to increase ~2.5x (primarily embeddings/real-time chat), and we're aiming for:

- Guaranteed p99 tail latency under 600ms for conversational endpoints (peak is important)
- 24/7 priority support with 15-minute P1 initial response and a named escalation engineer during business hours
- Dedicated capacity buffer during scheduled product launches (30% burst reserve)

We'd like a high-level commercial and operational view: incremental cost for Premium Response, any term commitments required, and what the runbook/onboarding looks like (on-call handoff, escalation matrix, runbook share). Can you also supply any SOC2/attestation timeline items if that impacts a private deployment?

If useful, we can schedule a 30-min call this week.

Thanks,
Luis Ortega
Head of Infrastructure, Horizon Health
procurement@horizonhealth.com

On a related note, attached is a spreadsheet with our projected monthly token growth for FY30 — that should help sizing the dedicated buffer when you look at capacity math.

Hi Luis — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the growth spreadsheet. We can absolutely support an elevated package that includes the latency SLO and a 24/7 priority channel. High-level answers below; attaching a draft Premium SLA addendum and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the migration/onboarding.

Summary options (ballpark monthly delta, illustr.):
- Premium Response Tier (24/7, 15-min P1): +$18k/month on top of current plan (includes named SE for business hours)
- Latency Banding (p99 ≤ 600ms) with dedicated capacity guardrail: +$25k/month (includes burst reserve + proactive scaling during launches)
- Package price (both): +$38k/month (5% discount if you commit 12 months)

Operational notes:
- Onboarding: 4-week technical ramp (week 0: runbook & SSO; week 1: traffic mirroring & baseline telemetry; week 2: scale tests; week 3: go-live run)
- Escalation: we provide a named SE + 24/7 pager for P1s; SRE on-call overlaps for high-severity incidents; full runbook exchange and playbook rehearsal included in onboarding
- Compliance: SOC2 artifacts available via secure portal; private deployment path possible but adds ~6-8 weeks for network & audit validations

Next steps I propose: 1) confirm target start date for the premium package (we can align start to your FY30 launch window), 2) decide on term length (6 vs 12 months; 12 gets discount), 3) we put a Statement of Work draft and DocuSign envelope.

I copied Ben (pricing) and Marissa (renewals/ops) to help with commercials and scheduling. If you want, Ben and I can join your procurement call Thurs 12:30–1:00pm PT.

Attachments: Redwood_SLA_Premium_Draft_20290614.pdf (SLA language + metrics), Horizon_MA_plan_v2.xlsx (incorporates your token projections)

Best,
Laura Bennett
